newsitem.title: USA: Dillon, Read lifts DM Management estimate.
newsitem.headline: Dillon, Read lifts DM Management estimate.

text.p: Dillon, Read & Co Inc said Tuesday it raised its estimate for DM Management Co's second quarter earnings to $0.20 a share from $0.15 previously.

Dillon, Read analysts Peter Schaeffer and Ashely Essex said they raised their estimates due to better customer response than expected to DM Management's late-spring mailings of J. Jill and Nicole Summers catalogs during the past six to eight weeks.

"The earnings revision is based upon an expected increase in sales of 50 percent over the last year, as announced by DM Management this morning," the analysts said in a researh report. They had expected a rise in sales of just 30 percent during the second quarter versus the same quarter last year.

Both the J. Jill and Nicole Summers catalogs have experienced growth from prospecting for new customers, but J. Jill has obtained a bigger percentage of the new customers due to the recent redesign of the catalog, the analysts said.
The analysts did not change their estimates for the third and fourth quarters. They raised their forecast for the full year to $0.56 a share from $0.51 to reflect the second-quarter adjustment.

DM Management's stock, which closed at $8 on Monday, was trading at 14 times the analysts' estimate for this year and 12 times their earnings estimate of $0.69 for next year, according to the research report.
